name: Canh la lim kim
summary: Canh lá lìm kìm is a soup of the same mangrove leaf with tôm and tép. The leaf is already salty and the shrimp is sweet, so the pot takes no added salt.
origin: Can Gio. A home pot, not a named stall.
howToEat: Cook it for an ordinary meal. The story says no salt goes in.
seoTitle: Canh la lim kim — mangrove leaf soup in Can Gio
seoDescription: Canh lá lìm kìm is a salty mangrove-leaf soup with sweet shrimp, and no added salt.
taste: The leaf’s own salt meets the clean sweetness of fresh shrimp.
